timing: Complete release Wasm processes with input, output and exit; no MoonX and no startup subtraction
slowdown_policy: The shared-foundation integration accepts the measured small abstraction costs. A ratio above this review boundary is never offset against another workload's gain.
coverage_policy: Compare every built command artifact with a frozen baseline. Every changed artifact needs a registered command profile. Run all registered profiles, including unchanged controls. Missing, failed or unstable evidence cannot pass. Unchanged artifacts do not establish upstream parity.

separate_required_evidence.sort-spill-8m: The pre-foundation baseline exceeded 20 seconds in warmup at -S 1M. Retain that failure. Validate the candidate with the same deadline and compare its bytes with the baseline default-budget sort; this is a repair observation, not an old/new speed ratio.
separate_required_evidence.resources: Observe kernel peak RSS, temporary residue and cleanup separately from timing. Single-pair resource observations are not stability qualification.
separate_required_evidence.correctness: Run the applicable Wasm unit and functional suites, including errors, partial output, cancellation, early exit, Unicode and binary cases. Timing fixture coverage alone is insufficient.

boundaries.retain: Exact imported table values and order, first-use construction without suspension, process-local cached tables, unchanged Unicode/encoding semantics and file-type definitions

Lazy bounded boolean-count construction, ordinary blocks no larger than 256 KiB, mandatory-literal filtering throughout each block, exact delimiter exclusion, assertion and empty-match rejection, cached budget decline, and the existing fallback engines
SIMD/SWAR kernels, fused counts, conservative prefilters and specialized regex semantics
Synchronous borrowed batches, explicit owned records, retained-view lifetime and original read sizes
Bounded output ownership, no asynchronous reuse, no replay after partial failure, prefix flush on read failure, diagnostics order and command formatting loops
Exclusive temporary ownership, exact range reads, independent reverse blocks, page caches and sort run layouts
Immutable execution plans and printer configuration built outside the output loop; explicit type-option errors precede input

Literal eligibility before input discard; decoder and binary policies; bounded unmatched suffix; one EOF completion; original fallback selected before streaming; command-owned search rules and unchanged regex matching priority
Catalog ownership separated from parsing, with unchanged option precedence and metadata contracts
Directory lifetime and explicit metadata queries; caller-owned ordering, pruning, links and error precedence
Algorithm parents separated from command cli adapters; digest and record formats, CRC, concatenated members, truncation and partial-output behavior
Typed incomplete/invalid syntax and loop control; independent exit, return and signal state; diagnostics, quoting, redirection and scope
Prepared header ownership and transfer-only execution; profile-specific authentication, framing, redirects, timeout and output cleanup
Explicit adaptive-cache failure state, required capability boundaries, launch policy and aligned/relative tab-stop overflow checks
